title: Stepping-phase persistence does not establish added cross-dataset Parkinson discrimination beyond coordination summaries
abstract: Lag-one bilateral stepping-phase persistence did not establish added Parkinson discrimination in the primary gaitndd-to-gaitpdb transfer beyond demographics, speed, stride summaries, swing asymmetry and a phase coordination index. Among 163 target records, baseline/augmented log loss was 0.629146/0.627390; paired gain 0.001756, conditional95% interval [-0.003643, 0.007133]. AUC was 0.747551/0.747857. Joint source/target refitting intervals included zero in both directions. This is a detector-dependent incremental prediction test, not evidence that physiological phase dynamics lack disease information.
